MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES — TERMLY EXAM #20
====

GRADE: Grade 3
SUBJECT: MOVEMENT AND CREATIVE ACTIVITIES
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KPSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Best practice when working on Melody: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Melody.
   B. Practise Melody with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Melody.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Melody.

2. Best practice when working on Songs: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Songs.
   B. Practise Songs with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   C. Damage equipment used for Songs.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Songs.

3. Primary colours are: (1 mark)
   A. Green, orange, and purple
   B. Brown, pink, and gold
   C. Red, blue, and yellow
   D. Black, white, and grey

4. Best practice when working on Singing games: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Singing games with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Singing games.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Singing games.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Singing games.

5. Best practice when working on Dance: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Dance with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Disrupt classmates during Dance.
   C. Damage equipment used for Dance.
   D. Refuse all feedback on Dance.

6. Best practice when working on Rhythm COMPOSING: (1 mark)
   A. Disrupt classmates during Rhythm COMPOSING.
   B. Damage equipment used for Rhythm COMPOSING.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Rhythm COMPOSING.
   D. Practise Rhythm COMPOSING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

7. In music, tempo refers to: (1 mark)
   A. Only the costume
   B. Only the volume
   C. The ticket price
   D. The speed of the music

8. Warming up before sport helps to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace drinking water
   B. Prepare muscles and reduce injury risk
   C. Guarantee a trophy
   D. Remove the need for rules

9. Best practice when working on Musical Instruments: (1 mark)
   A. Refuse all feedback on Musical Instruments.
   B. Damage equipment used for Musical Instruments.
   C. Disrupt classmates during Musical Instruments.
   D. Practise Musical Instruments with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.

10. Best practice when working on Elements of AND RESPONDING: (1 mark)
   A. Practise Elements of AND RESPONDING with discipline, creativity, and respect for others.
   B. Damage equipment used for Elements of AND RESPONDING.
   C. Refuse all feedback on Elements of AND RESPONDING.
   D. Disrupt classmates during Elements of AND RESPONDING.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
11. In three clear sentences, explain Songs and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

12. In three clear sentences, explain Singing games and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

13. In three clear sentences, explain Musical Instruments and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Dance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Rhythm COMPOSING and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain Melody and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
